notes.title: This Side Up Demo 2.0 out now!
notes.content:
[h2]New look and feel[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709350/be7cadfcefe7c6913f1c7086779f5c9c153772f9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709350/be7cadfcefe7c6913f1c7086779f5c9c153772f9.gif[/img][/url]

Players and boxes have perspective elements, and movement is smoother than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709350/92c72f620d46aa28825e815ff90db109e477f54b.gif[/img]

Cosmetic elements have also been added to bring the game world to life.

[h2]Company time[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709350/d8c9c73b96bd823f195cf7d2187c514d460e67c4.gif[/img]

The in game timer now syncs times with a global leaderboard, so you can see how you hold up!
